checks: For any admissible coupling each hinge has a nonnegative Jensen deficit. A positive-weight finite sum is zero exactly when every active deficit is zero. The set of active margins cannot be empty because beta and the common total mass are positive.

At a source with positive margin the affine support is L_i, so the remainder is the negative part of the target margin. At a negative source it is the positive part of the target margin. Affineness and the physical conditional mean identify the integral of each remainder with J_i. Its nonnegativity forces preservation of the corresponding closed side at zero deficit. Source and target boundary-nullness give the same strict sign almost surely, jointly for the finite active list.

Every active sign cell is invariant under the coupling. The source-to-capacity density is constant on that cell, so equality of transported cell masses forces the constant to be one on positive-capacity cells. The same density statement is on the whole labelled cell and proves equality of the labelled measures directly.

For equal physical marginals the squared Euclidean displacement integral is their second-moment difference by the martingale identity, hence zero. Compact physical support guarantees finite second moments. This argument works for every admissible coupling. In the converse direction existence makes the universal identity condition nonvacuous. In the labelled case physical identity and label preservation together yield equality of the labelled marginals.

overlap.comparison: The compact convex-order theorem supplies a general martingale equivalence. It does not derive equality of the measures from active hinge equality and the special incidence density.
The marked convex-order theorem concerns existence of parameter-preserving martingales. It does not have this active-hinge criterion or the resulting labelled marginal identity.

readability: The identity condition is in the full physical coordinates. The measurable label need not itself have a Euclidean structure because it is preserved by the assumed coupling.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: Under the boundary-null and full-mass hypotheses, zero active hinge deficits, equality of measures and physical identity of every admissible martingale are equivalent. The argument also handles a preserved measurable label.
